audit.claim: The audited dataset instance contains no exact duplicate feature samples within partitions and no exact feature overlap across audited partitions.
audit.name: Exact Duplicate and Partition Overlap Census

schema.feature_encoding: canonical Gohr feature encoding returned by speck.make_train_data; no representation conversion is applied by the D1 driver
schema.representation_convention: canonical feature array returned by speck.make_train_data

limitations: D1 requires consistent computational schema across audited partitions before exact duplicate/overlap results are considered valid.
Representation convention and feature encoding are semantic properties and are enforced only when explicitly supplied by the dataset-specific driver.
D1 addresses exact equality only. It does not establish the absence of near duplicates or statistical dependence.

If the audited data were regenerated from a generation procedure, the certificate describes the generated dataset instance actually supplied to D1; it does not retroactively certify an unavailable historical dataset instance.
A zero-overlap result is evidence that no exact overlap was observed in the audited data under the stated representation. It is not evidence that all forms of dataset correlation are absent.

methodology.decision_rule: PASS iff all audited feature/label schemas are consistent, every audited partition contains zero exact duplicate samples, and every compatible audited partition pair contains zero exact feature overlap.
methodology.inferential_scope: exact duplicates and exact feature overlap only

audit_configuration.feature_encoding: canonical Gohr feature encoding returned by speck.make_train_data; no representation conversion is applied by the D1 driver
audit_configuration.hash_scope: sample dtype + sample shape + contiguous raw sample bytes
audit_configuration.representation_convention: canonical feature array returned by speck.make_train_data
